text:
emily: Quick heads-up — we've added a new dedicated GPU offering: NVIDIA L40S (48GB) in us-west-2 (Oregon). Reservations are open for customers on Dedicated and Dedicated+ starting today. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated/l40s-us-west-2

ben-k: Nice! Any changes to routing or model support? Will `gpt-neox` variants be supported on L40S?

emily: L40S is targeted for inference-heavy, low-cost workloads (embeddings, smaller decoder-only models). Model catalog tag `l40s-optimized` added. To route: set `deployment.hardware` = `l40s` or use policy `prefer:l40s` in the route config. No change to public API surface.

sridhar: Pricing/throughput numbers?

billing-bot: L40S (dedicated) = $1.95/GPU-hour baseline. Burst pool billing prorated by minute. Expected throughput: ~1.8x A10 for short sequences; latency numbers included in doc.

dave: FYI earlier today during the prep window we saw a brief capacity sync issue in us-west-2 that increased queueing for ~2-3 mins around 10:22 PDT. No customer impact reported, autoscaler corrected, root cause: mismatch in placement constraints during rolling deploy. We've applied a fix to the placement service.

emily: Thanks @dave — that incident is tracked: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-042. We're keeping a 24h observational window. If you see unexpected fallback to older GPU classes, ping #eng-oncall.

ben-k: Is there any change to reservation limits? Some customers asked about 100->200 GPU limit.

emily: For now, max per-customer reservation remains 200 GPUs in us-west-2. We're allowing exception requests via the sales portal; include expected sustained utilization and SLOs. Also new policy: we cap burst-pool tickets per-customer to avoid noisy neighbors.

sridhar: Rollout timeline?

emily: Phase 1 (today): Reserved capacity live for Dedicated customers in us-west-2. Phase 2 (next 2 weeks): enable Dedicated+ customers + console UI for reservations. Phase 3 (end of month): add eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 availability (subject to vendor shipping).

dave: QA note — please run `make infra-smoke` in your dev env if you depend on placement service changes.

emily: Any major blockers, @product-team? Otherwise I'll post a customer-facing note tomorrow morning and update the release notes.

product-team: 👍 looks good. Could you add a short blurb for the pricing page and include examples for embeddings cost savings?

emily: Will do. :tada:

ops-bot: Capacity monitor resolved alert: cw-alarm/us-west-2/l40s-capacity (cleared at 1769501405)
